<entry id="H00736">
<head-word>חַיִּים</head-word>
<pos> m. pl.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> חָיָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>life, support; health</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> חַיֵּי עולם everlasting life (future world), ח' שעה temporary life (physical wants).—חיי נפש 
<italic>necessaries of life</italic>. Y. Ned. 
<pgbrk id="pg455" />IX, 42
<sup>c</sup>
<sup />כביסה ח' נ' washing clothes belongs to the necessaries of life (which the poor must be supplied with). Ib. ח' העיר הזאת the support of the poor of one’s own place. Pes. 113
<sup>b</sup> חַיֵּיהֶם אינם חיים whose life is no life (deserving the name); a. v. fr.—חַיֶּיךָ, בְּחַ' by thy life!, 
<italic>as thou livest!</italic> Lev. R. s. 15; a. v. fr.—Ber. 3
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. חַיֶּיךָ וחַיֵּי ראשך by thy life, and by thy head!—יורד עמו (עד) לחַיָּיו persecutes him even as far as to deprive him of his livelihood. Kidd. 28
<sup>a</sup>. Ex. R. s. 1, beg.; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 19 בית חַיֵּינוּ our house of life (the Temple). Mekh. Yithro, Amal., s. 2 (ref. to Ex. XVIII, 20) הודע להם בית חַיֵּיהֶם make known to them their house of life (prayer, study; v. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.); B. Mets. 30
<sup>b</sup>; B. Kam. 99
<sup>b</sup>, sq. (v. comment.).—[חַיִּים 
<italic>the living ones</italic>, v. חַי.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>
